title: Built a multiplayer browser based dog park
author: In_Mani_Ylem
selftext:
Now that Fable came back, I decided to try messing around with some ThreeJS + Colyseus to make a chill multiplayer dog park. 

The dog park is a shared lobby where you can chat with other players, play with your dog, and play with other people's dogs. There are various agility courses you can run your dog through and there are toys that can be thrown that the dogs will interact with. Check it out and let me know what you think! Currently desktop browser only.

[https://woof.unusual.games/](https://woof.unusual.games/)

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Needs sound, there are free sound libraries you can use.

replies.author: In_Mani_Ylem
replies.body: Yes, I was planning on adding some. However, a lot of my friends who have been playing it play it as a background idler game when they are at work / doing other things, so they would all mute it if it had sound, so I've been hesitant for now.

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Then add an option to turn the sound off. And you should from more than just your friends if you want scale it.

replies.author: In_Mani_Ylem
replies.body: Thats why I posted it here. It's only 1 day of work so far.

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: You're making one of the most common mistakes marketing; asking other developers. You need to be developing relationships and asking your target audience.

comments.author: Unusual_Archer9443
comments.body: How did you make the animations smooth?

replies.author: In_Mani_Ylem
replies.body: I used actual 3D models and animations from an asset pack, they aren't AI generated.

comments.author: MunchyCerealGuy
comments.body: Can you make the walking speed a little faster? It's frustratingly slow

replies.author: In_Mani_Ylem
replies.body: Sure I can look into tweaking it. You can also use SHIFT to sprint.
